conbody.p: Before installing, confirm the workstation meets the following minimum requirements: 64-bit Windows 10/11 or macOS 12+, 8 GB RAM (16 GB recommended), 20 GB free disk space, and a DirectX 11 / Metal-capable graphics card.
conbody.note: Administrator rights are required to complete installation. Confirm this with your IT team before starting if you are on a managed device.
